messages:
Priya (finance): Quick company-wide note on procurement norms for Q1: we've tightened p-card single-charge limits and introduced a delegated vendor approval flow for low-risk tools. Please read and act if you own recurring subscriptions. TL;DR: update your vendor list by Jan 28; follow delegated flow for <$2k/year low-risk SaaS. Spreadsheet + flow doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/q1-procurement-2026 :loudspeaker:
Noah (procurement): Details: 1) p-card single-charge cap lowered to $1,000 without prior approval. 2) Recurring subscriptions over $100/month need a procurement intake entry. 3) New delegated approval: team leads can approve vendors classified as "low-risk" (no PII, SOC2 not required) up to $2k/year.
Cam (engineering): For infra add-ons billed by AWS partners, do they count toward the $100/mo recurring rule?
Noah (procurement): Yes, any external recurring line item counts. If it's on an AWS invoice but billed by a third party (marketplace or managed service), include it.
Ruth (ops): Quick workflow note: delegated approvals require the team lead's email and a short justification in the intake form. We'll auto-generate a PO when approved.
Ivy (security): Addendum: anything that touches customer PII or PHI is never eligible for delegated approval. Mark that column on the intake form and security will pick it up for review. Expect 3 business days SLA for initial triage.
Priya (finance): New vendor-risk threshold: any vendor with expected spend > $2,000/year requires a vendor-risk questionnaire (VRQ) and vendor manager assignment. Procurement will reach out to you to complete the VRQ.
procure-bot: Reminder imported: procurement-intake form updated at 07:00 UTC. Template fields: vendor_name, annual_estimate, cost_center, owner_email, contract_term, handles_pii, expedite_flag.
Noah (procurement): Please use consistent tags in the intake. Suggested tag snippet to copy into exports:

```
vendor_name: LogStream
annual_estimate: $1800
cost_center: infra
owner_email: cam@redwood.com
contract_term: 12mo
handles_pii: no
```
Priya (finance): Note on timing: entries submitted after Jan 28 may be deferred to the next procurement cycle and could delay vendor activation/payment. If you need an emergency onboarding, file an "exception" ticket in #help-procurement and tag @Noah.
Cam (engineering): Understood. One ask: can procurement expose an API/csv endpoint for our billing automation so we can sync tags?
Noah (procurement): We're piloting an exports endpoint next month. For now drop CSVs into the intake sheet and use the exact column names. We'll announce the API once available.
Ruth (ops): For teams that use charge cards for contractors, remember contractor charges still need receipts and the charge code. If missing, payment may be delayed.
Ivy (security): If vendors ask for expedited security review, mark "expedite" and include a short threat model note. We will triage but can't guarantee faster than 48 hours depending on workload.
Priya (finance): Thanks everyone. Action items: teams, update the intake sheet by 2026-01-28 COB with recurring vendors; team leads, be ready to approve delegated low-risk vendors; reach out in #help-procurement for exceptions. I'll post a short FAQ doc later today. :memo:
